Lemma
[Properties of Tangent Vectors on Manifolds]

1. ch3:3.4Let $M$ be a smooth manifold, possibly with boundary, let $p\in M$ and $v\in T_pM$, and let $f,g\in C^\infty (M)$. Then:

  1. if $f$ is constant, then $v(f)=0$;

  2. if $f(p)=g(p)=0$, then $v(fg)=0$.
